links.outcome: Recognition of suicidality and risk stratification across psychiatric vignettes
links.effect: Clinical reasoning worsened with case complexity, especially for suicidality safeguards and risk stratification, in ChatGPT-4o, ChatGPT-4.5 and DeepSeek-R1.
links.quote: Nevertheless, consistent with past findings, clinical reasoning worsened as case complexity increased; this was especially apparent for suicidality safeguards and risk stratification.

links.outcome: Output variance across repeated runs of the vignettes
links.effect: Output variance was noted in several cases.
links.quote: Finally, output variance was noted in several cases, and the LLMs occasionally failed to clarify their inability to prescribe medication.

links.outcome: Adherence of pharmacological recommendations to established guidelines and diagnostic completeness
links.effect: Pharmacological recommendations frequently diverged from established guidelines; primary diagnoses broadly accurate but often omitted somatic factors and comorbidities.
links.quote: Pharmacological recommendations frequently diverged from established guidelines, whilst cultural adaptations remained largely superficial.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation comparing psychiatric assessment and intervention performance across multiple LLM models (ChatGPT iterations and DeepSeek-R1) using clinical vignettes evaluated by psychiatrists.
